run_NER_extraction: run the NER model to extract medical terms from clinical trial eligibility criteria text
create_OfflinePredictor: create an OfflinePredictor instance from a Caffe2 model file for named entity recognition
predict_medical_entities: predict medical entity slots from text using the OfflinePredictor and group results by label
tokenize_text: tokenize input text with an optional begin-of-sentence token using the Transformer module
group_slots: group consecutive word predictions by label into named entity slots with averaged confidence scores
